form.label: LDAP - Security Dashboard
form.description: Comprehensive AD security and compliance monitoring

html.p: How it shows: Checks for Kerberos delegation, password not required, don't require preauthentication (AS-REP roasting), SIDHistory, and Key Credential Links (Shadow Credentials).

panel.title: Accounts with Highest Risks (Critical Attack Paths)

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | where(isnotnull('msDS-KeyCredentialLink') OR isnotnull(sIDHistory) OR isnotnull('msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo') OR (LIKE(userAccountControl,"%DONT_REQ_PREAUTH%")) OR (LIKE(userAccountControl,"%TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION%")) OR (LIKE(userAccountControl,"%SERVER_TRUST_ACCOUNT%")) OR (LIKE(userAccountControl,"%PASSWD_NOTREQD%")) OR (LIKE(userAccountControl,"%TRUSTED_TO_AUTH_FOR_DELEGATION%"))) | eval criticalflags="sIDHistory: " . coalesce(sIDHistory,"N/A") . " | msDS-KeyCredentialLink: " . coalesce('msDS-KeyCredentialLink',"N/A") . " | msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo : " . coalesce('msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo',"N/A") | eval hasdisabled=if(match(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE"),1,0) | where hasdisabled = 0 | table displayName,cn,criticalflags,userAccountControl

html.p: What it shows: Risky mailbox configurations including shared mailboxes (MFA bypass), disabled auditing, and litigation hold status.

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | where (msExchRecipientTypeDetails=256 OR msExchMailboxAuditEnable=0) | table displayName,sAMAccountName,msExchRecipientTypeDetails,msExchMailboxAuditEnable,msExchELCMailboxFlags,msExchHomeServerName

html.p: What it shows: Accounts that have been modified recently (within 10 days) but existed before the change.

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | eval lastchange_epoch=strptime(whenChanged,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S+00:00") | eval days_since_change = floor((now()-lastchange_epoch)/86400) | where days_since_change < 10 AND whenCreated < whenChanged | table cn,days_since_change,whenChanged,whenCreated,userAccountControl | sort - whenChanged

html.p: What it shows: Accounts that have accessed mailboxes with admin privileges within the last 30 days.

panel.title: Exchange Admin Access and Insider Threat (30 days)

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | where isnotnull(msExchMailboxAuditLastAdminAccess) | eval adminaccess_epoch=strptime(msExchMailboxAuditLastAdminAccess,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S+00:00") | eval days_since_admin_access = floor((now()-adminaccess_epoch)/86400) | where days_since_admin_access < 30 | table cn,sAMAccountName,days_since_admin_access,msExchMailboxAuditLastAdminAccess,userAccountControl
